title: Ndop styled item
description: Scaffold a styled registry item (ADR-0021): the directive at registry/ui/<name>/<name>.ts, its test, docs.md, the registry.json entry at 0.1.0 and its changelog.

name.description: Item name in kebab-case, for example `radio-group`.

title.description: Display name, when it isn't the name in title case, for example `Input OTP`.

description.description: One sentence on what the item is, for registry.json and the directive's TSDoc.

category.description: Docs group: the item's first `categories` entry (ADR-0021).

primitive.description: Compose the primitive `@ndop/primitives/<name>` as a host directive and depend on `@ndop/primitives`.
